title: I built a tool that turns plain-English strategy ideas into editable Python backtests
author: csurkepulyka
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/1lff6g2g87bh1.gif

Hey everyone — I just launched BacktestLoop and would love some feedback from people who actually backtest strategies.

The original idea was simple: I wanted to describe a strategy in plain English, have the AI generate editable Backtrader Python, run the backtest, and then inspect the actual trades, logs, equity curve, drawdown, and metrics.

It has grown quite a bit since then. Some of the main things it can do now:

* Build strategies from plain English
* Paste a YouTube link and let the AI watch the video + implement the strategy (it watches the video, not just gets the transcript)
* Backtest stocks, futures, forex, and crypto
* Use historical data going back up to 26 years
* Run timeframes from 1 second up to 1 week
* Model realistic trading costs with built-in broker fee/commission presets for IBKR, Alpaca, NinjaTrader, OANDA, and others
* Run multi-timeframe strategies
* Train ML models on market data and use them in backtests
* Run parallel strategy experiments and compare variations
* Use Backtrader for event-driven realism or VectorBT for faster vectorized tests
* Connect Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor through MCP
* Integrate into any software with the BacktestLoop API

The whole product is built around shortening the research loop: idea → implementation → historical data → backtest → logs/trades/metrics → iteration (you can keep improving the strategy / results just by chatting with the AI agent).

The thing I personally care about most is being able to see what was actually tested. I don’t just want an equity curve — I want the Python code, the logs, the trades, and the assumptions, so I can tweak it and understand where the result came from. Also I wanted a nice way to just keep improving the strategy, rather than just generating it one time and that's it. So it is like ChatGPT but for backtesting (you can send follow up messages and tell the agent to improve the PNL etc)

Would love honest feedback. Is this useful for people here, or is it trying to do too much?

[https://backtestloop.com](https://backtestloop.com)
